text: たたかい　おわっても　ねたまま　ねむけざましで　めが　さめます

structure.jp: たたかい　おわっても

patterns.name: 〜ても
patterns.explanation: A て-verb plus も means 'even if' or 'even when' that happens. たたかい おわっても = 'even when the battle ends'.

patterns.name: 〜たまま
patterns.explanation: A past-form verb plus まま means things stay just as they were after that action. ねたまま = 'still asleep'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で here tells you what is used to make it happen. ねむけざましで = 'with an Awakening'.
